RDAP lookup reveals the IP is registered to Artikel10 e.V. in Germany under the organization ARTIKEL10.
A dedicated Tor exit node check confirms that 185.220.101.1 is currently operating as a verified Tor exit node.

recommendations: Treat traffic originating from this IP address with caution due to its status as a Tor exit node.
Implement context-aware access controls if connections from anonymization networks violate organizational policy.
gaps: No specific malicious payload delivery or targeted exploitation attempts could be directly attributed to the IP beyond standard security scanner and honeypot interaction logs typical of public exit nodes.
